svg.title: Brightfield imaging in a cage system
svg.desc: Editable transmitted-light microscope using Science-symbols library components. Infinity objective and matched tube lens, accessible specimen gap and split cage rails. Optical passages and specimen edge are schematic. Reference: https://www.thorlabs.com/newgrouppage9.cfm?objectgroup_id=5834
